source_evidence: Client fees may also be based on the value of assets in your account. These “asset-based fees” might be ongoing, whether there are transactions in your account or not.
answer: Advisory fees can be structured in different ways. An hourly fee is based on the time an adviser spends giving advice. A fixed or flat fee may be based on that time or on specific transactions, such as buying or selling securities. An asset-based fee is calculated based on the value of assets in your account and may continue even when no transactions occur. Before opening an account, understand how each fee is calculated and which fees apply.
